description: Intraday breadth time series for one trading day (240 minute bars; 13:00 excluded — ticks at the lunch-break boundary are too sparse). `trade_date` omitted = today (pre-open returns empty); explicit YYYY-MM-DD = historical replay. Returns per-minute rows of up/down/flat/limit_up/limit_down/breadth/divergence fields — full mode matches `sentiment_overview`; compact omits long summaries and extended breadth fields. Coverage reports source and returned time ranges. Budget trimming retains latest points, ascending.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

fields.description: 响应模式；REST/CLI 默认 full，MCP 默认 compact（导出除外）

last_n.description: 仅返回最近 N 个交易分钟点，午休不计入

scope.description: Universe filter: all_a | all_a_ex_st (default, ex-ST + ex-newly-listed) | st_only | main_board | star_market | chinext | bse. The four boards sum exactly to all_a_ex_st.

trade_date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today

name: sentiment_breadth
